correctness.rationale: The rephased deleted Gram matrix is real symmetric with kernel 1+2cos(2πd/N), and Parseval subtraction equates the retained least eigenvalue with 1-λmax/N. Consecutive-deletion eigenvalues are derived explicitly. For N≥8, absolute-entrywise Perron monotonicity is strict for any nonconsecutive triple; N=7 has the strict 3+a+d Gershgorin versus (3+(4a+2b)/3) Rayleigh comparison, with (6-2a-b)/3>0; N=6 all cyclic gap types are computed. Vandermonde spanning and Taylor limits are proved. Finite enumeration is supplementary.

value.rationale: The exact worst-case retained squared lower frame bound is a natural stability invariant for reconstructing a three-dimensional Fourier signal after three adversarial measurement losses. The formula applies to every integer cycle order, classifies precisely N minimizing masks, and reveals a sharp geometric clustering obstruction. This goes beyond a lower bound for an arbitrary mask, finite experimentation or the already established two-row erasure case, and is explicitly limited to three consecutive Fourier frequencies and three lost coefficients.
